metadata.name: foobar2000
metadata.summary: Advanced audio player featuring seamless playback, high customization, and broad format support

content.value: foobar2000 is an advanced freeware audio player designed for seamless playback, high customization, and extensive audio format support on the desktop. Packaged for portable deployment on Linux systems using Wine-based compatibility, it brings the classic high-performance audio experience to a wide range of distributions without requiring complex setup.

The portable Linux build bundles all necessary runtime dependencies and incorporates an integrated updater mechanism to ensure seamless maintenance and compatibility across both standard and musl-based environments.

items.value: Comprehensive support for a wide variety of audio formats and seamless gapless playback
Fully self-contained runtime environment with no external FUSE or container requirements
Integrated self-updater that alerts users to new releases and coordinates with system package managers
Broad compatibility across modern, legacy, and musl-based Linux distributions
Extensive interface customization and advanced tagging capabilities
